'''Vassya Stefanova Bankova''' ({{langx|bg|Вася Стефанова Банкова|Vasya Stefanova Bankova}}; born 1954, in [[Sofia]]<ref name="a">{{cite web |title=LABORATORY CHEMISTRY OF NATURAL PRODUCTS |url=http://www.orgchm.bas.bg/~bankova/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130420044819/http://www.orgchm.bas.bg/~bankova/ |archive-date=2013-04-20 |website=www.orgchm.bas.bg}}</ref>) is a Bulgarian chemist and a president of the Bulgarian Phytochemical Society,<ref>{{cite web |title=Propolis conference Sofia 2018 |url=http://propolisconference2018.cim.bg/organizing-commitee/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180109121850/http://propolisconference2018.cim.bg/organizing-commitee/ |archive-date=2018-01-09 |website=propolisconference2018.cim.bg}}</ref> Correspondent Member of the [[Bulgarian Academy of Sciences]] since 2014. Bankova is a professor and Chief of the Chemistry of Natural Compounds Laboratory, at the Institute of Organic Chemistry with Centre of Phytochemistry (IOCCP), Bulgarian Academy of Sciences. She is also an honorary professor on the [[Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy, Sofia University]]. She is known as a [[propolis]] expert.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://propoelix.com/en_US/bankova/|title=Prof. Dr. Vassya BANKOVA - Propoelix|website=propoelix.com}}</ref>

She graduated from the [[University of Chemical Technology and Metallurgy]] in 1977.<ref name="a" /> She obtained her PhD at the IOCCP in 1990,<ref name="a" /> and obtained her degree of [[Doktor nauk]] (DSc.) from the same institute in 2000.<ref name="a" />

In 2005 she was promoted to a Full Professor at the IOCCP.<ref name="a" />
Since 2009, the Chief of the IOCCP Chemistry of Natural Compounds Laboratory.<ref name="a" />

She is a member of the Editorial Board of ''[[Chemistry Central]] Journal''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/chemistry/journal/13065?detailsPage=editorialBoard|title=Chemistry Central Journal (Editorial Board)|website=springer.com|access-date=2018-01-29|archive-date=2018-06-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180621170757/https://www.springer.com/chemistry/journal/13065?detailsPage=editorialBoard|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Works==
*V. Bankova. Chemical diversity of propolis and the problem of standardization. [[J. Ethnopharmacol.]] 100 (1-2), 114—117 (2005).
*V. Bankova, B. Trusheva., M.Popova. New developments in propolis chemical diversity studies (since 2000) In: N. Orsolich & I. Basic (Eds), Scientific Evidence of Use of Propolis in Ethnomedicine, 1-13, Transworld Research Network, Trivandrum, 2008.
*V. Bankova, B. Trusheva. Chemical profiles of different propolis types in relation to their biological activity. In: T. Farooki and A. Farooki, Eds., Beneficial effects of propolis on human health and chronic diseases. [[Nova Science Publishers]], New York. 2013.
